originality_checks: Avoid exact famous titles when a fresh title works.
Reject phrases that sound like stock motivational quotes.
Reject generic heartbreak images unless a specific action makes them personal.
Prefer ordinary specific behavior over dramatic abstract metaphors.
Use the user's theme words as seeds, not as repeated slogans unless they score well.
Do not generate artist names inside lyrics.
Do not use recognizable song titles as hook phrases when avoidable.
